ECE 6390

Exam 1

Orbital motion, look angles, spacecraft resources, traveling fields, basic antennas, and received link quality.

Reading sequence

  1. Read the Mission as One Connected Calculation
  2. Choose an Orbit Before Choosing the Radio
  3. Turn an Orbital Position Into a Direction in the Sky
  4. Keep the Whole Spacecraft Working
  5. Follow the Electromagnetic Wave
  6. Turn Wire Current Into an Antenna Pattern
  7. Follow Power Through the Radio Link
